text: [a very old man recalling a terrible secret, low and precise, clearly intelligible unhurried speech] Thirteenth night. The Count's orrery carries a planet that does not exist, and its socket stands empty. I set the hallowed hilt there, where the brass wanders and the third moon should be.
reference_text: I can hear your heart. It is very loud, in my house. Stay a little longer. We have all the time in the world.
